purpose: Discover canonical project source locations without retrieving source bodies, then retrieve and persist a bounded, task-relevant evidence pack from recorded accessible sources.

deliverable.name: Local project-context projection: manifest.json, brief.md and a ranked evidence pack
deliverable.path_or_form: workspace/.system/project-context/ under the opportunity root, deliberately untracked
deliverable.note: There is no client-facing document here, so this suite has no golden-document comparison and a thin correctness surface by nature. The document-producing skills downstream of this one are where the reference-based capability evaluation belongs.

human_baseline.note: No human effort has been timed for assembling a Risk Gate 1 evidence pack by hand. Record a timed manual run or a dated delivery-lead estimate before any time saving is reported for this workflow.

golden_reference.note: The deliverable is machine-local state rather than a document a human would otherwise write, so no known-good human version exists to compare against.

expected_skill_invocations_note: Not currently observable: the deterministic harness invokes the scripts directly, so nothing in this suite proves a model would have chosen these skills. Recorded here so an agentic arm can assert it later.
required_clarifying_questions: Confirm the opportunity root before writing a local projection
Confirm the concrete task before retrieving source content
required_clarifying_questions_note: Not currently observable for the same reason: there is no user turn in a script-driven run.

inputs: Bounded source metadata and content chunks
outputs: Ranked evidence pack and access-gap record
environment: Fresh temporary workspace per run, removed afterwards
Scrubbed environment with the developer's home redirected to a throwaway directory
Network blocked and enforced, not merely assumed
Only recorded sources may be retrieved
Unavailable and unknown sources remain visible as access gaps

success_conditions: Canonical source locations and bounded discovery measurements are recorded without source bodies.
Relevant accessible evidence is selected within diversity and character limits.
Unavailable sources produce access gaps without leaking their body or widening retrieval.
Persisted context retains a summary-to-evidence hierarchy and cache reuse respects freshness and task relevance.
trajectory_requirements: Do not use an alternate connector or broaden search around an unavailable recorded source.
known_failure_modes: Source-body leakage into metadata or access gaps
failure_mode_provenance_note: We guessed these failures from the design; we have not yet watched it fail for real. Derived from the skill contract and scripts, not from error analysis on observed traces. Re-derive the taxonomy by open coding and axial coding real skill traces before treating these as representative, and do not attach frequencies to them until then.

reproducibility.claim: The graded artifacts are identical across repeated runs over the same pinned fixture, once two declared timestamp-derived fields are accounted for. The suite fails on any cross-run difference it has not declared.
reproducibility.not_a_cost_claim: This is reproducibility of the output, not consistency of cost. This suite measures no tokens, so it cannot answer how much the cost jumps around.
